translations.web: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
translations.bsb: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
translations.kjv: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
